functionalReqs: Customer adds items to a cart (from one restaurant), applies coupons, places an order
Order status: placed → accepted → preparing → picked up → delivered / cancelled
Notify customer, restaurant and partner on status changes
hints: A cart and an order are different things. When does a cart become an order?
Order states and coupon types each vary: State for one, Strategy or Decorator for the other.

Restaurant, Menu, MenuItem, Cart, Order (State), OrderItem, Coupon (Strategy: flat, percentage, BOGO), DeliveryAssignmentStrategy, NotificationService (Observer on order events), PaymentService interface, OrderFactory converts Cart to Order with price snapshot.
nonFunctionalReqs: Coupons and assignment logic easily extended
problemStatement: Design the classes for a **food delivery** app: restaurants with menus, customer carts and orders, order status updates, and delivery-partner assignment.
title: Design a Food Delivery App (LLD)
